result_text:
`PromotionService.createPromotion` now strips the promotion code (`code = code.strip();`) right after the blank check. I didn't add a test for the new behaviour. I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='Promotion*'` and it finished with no errors.

The stripped code is the one used for the duplicate check and the one that gets saved. So "  SPRING10 " is stored and listed as `SPRING10`, and creating `SPRING10` again, with or without spaces, is rejected as a duplicate.

I left `limitToRegion` alone, so it still looks the code up exactly as given. Passing it a code with spaces around it will still fail with "Unknown promotion code".

The change is one line, in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/service/PromotionService.java`. Nothing is committed.
